title: 第1146章 启程在即丹道双尊悲痛送行第1145章 狴犴血脉鸾凤造化池
slug: 我气运之子反派系统什么鬼
content_zh:
苏青秋斜倚在椅背上，见墨羽走近，素手轻扬，将一枚水晶法宝扔了过去。
青碧色的狐狸眼弯成月牙，红唇微启，娇声调笑。
“世间万般锦绣荣华，不及身畔一人相伴~”
“哎呀呀，皇夫大人，听到这等深情告白，是不是感动得快哭了？”
墨羽一把接住水晶，神识一探，里面装着整个雪灵族。
他随手将其收起，无奈地笑了笑。
“青秋姐姐就别拿我寻开心了。”
就在这时，虚空中血光微聚。
凤九幽的身影凭空浮现。
如今她周身血气尽敛，乍看之下，倒似个风情万种、妖冶勾人的绝代佳人。
她双手环抱胸前，眸光透着几分古怪，上下打量着墨羽，撇了撇红唇，满腹狐疑道。
“你竟是小白虎的皇夫……”
“你们人族男子的体魄，当真能扛得住神兽白虎那狂暴霸道的力量？”
此言一出，站在一旁的黛泠绾脑袋瞬间垂得更低了。
扛得住？
何止是扛得住！
甚至能将堂堂女帝干得丢盔卸甲、娇啼求饶。
自己小腹里现在都还……
究竟谁才是被压榨的那一方啊。
墨羽迎着凤九幽的目光，微微挑眉。

“九幽姐姐若是不信我的实力……”
“咱们大可封印仙力，纯用肉身干上一架。”
凤九幽红唇微撇，不以为意地轻嗤一声。
“那还是免了吧，我可没这兴致。”
黛泠绾轻咳一声，上前禀报。
“殿下，与人族圣源界的跨界传送阵已连通，阵法随时可启。”
墨羽环顾四周，发现少了几道身影。
他让众女稍候，径直折返，走向食府后厨。
推开厨房大门，热浪与仙膳的香气扑面而来。
甄饴安与武嫙溟两女依旧在灶台前忙碌不停。
高温之下，两女皆是香汗淋漓。
薄薄的法衣早被汗水浸透，紧紧贴伏于肌肤之上，将那玲珑浮凸的腰线与丰腴傲人的身段勾勒得纤毫毕现，春光半掩，勾人至极。
墨羽倚在门沿，温声开口。
“饴安。”
“甜芯和我说，你也想和我们一起走。”
“食府这边的摊子，我已经托人帮你打理了，收拾一下，跟我们走吧。”
甄饴安手中翻炒的动作猛地一顿，惊愕地回过头。
content_en:
Su Qingqiu was leaning on the back of the chair. Seeing Mo Yu approaching, she lightly raised her hand and threw a crystal magic weapon over.
The green fox eyes curved into crescent moons, the red lips were slightly parted, and she smiled coquettishly.
"All the splendor and splendor in the world is nothing compared to having one person by your side~"
"Oh, my lord, are you so moved that you almost cry when you hear this affectionate confession?"
Mo Yu caught the crystal and looked into it with his spiritual consciousness. It contained the entire Xueling clan.
He put it away casually and smiled helplessly.
"Sister Qingqiu, please stop making fun of me."
At this moment, blood light gathered in the void.
Feng Jiuyou's figure appeared out of thin air.
Now that all the blood in her body has been drained, at first glance, she looks like a charming, seductive and peerless beauty.
She crossed her arms across her chest, her eyes looked a bit strange, she looked up and down at Mo Yu, curled her red lips, and said suspiciously.
"You are actually the royal husband of Little White Tiger..."
"Can you human men really withstand the violent and domineering power of the mythical beast White Tiger?"
As soon as these words came out, Dai Lingwan, who was standing aside, lowered his head instantly.
Can you bear it?
More than just able to bear it!
He can even fuck the majestic empress until she throws off her armor and screams for mercy.
I still have it in my lower abdomen...
Who is the one being exploited?
Mo Yu met Feng Jiuyou's gaze and raised his eyebrows slightly.
"If Sister Jiuyou doesn't believe in my strength..."
"We can seal the immortal power and fight with our physical bodies."
Feng Jiuyou's red lips curled up slightly and she snorted indifferently.
"Then let's skip it, I'm not in the mood."
Dai Lingwan coughed slightly and stepped forward to report.
"Your Highness, the cross-border teleportation array with the human race's Holy Origin Realm has been connected, and the array can be activated at any time."
Mo Yu looked around and found a few figures missing.
He asked the girls to wait, then turned back and headed towards the kitchen of the restaurant.
Pushing open the kitchen door, the heat and the aroma of fairy food hit your face.
The two girls, Zhen Yi'an and Wu Kuoming, were still busy in front of the stove.
Under the high temperature, both women were dripping with sweat.
The thin cassock had long been soaked with sweat and clung tightly to the skin, outlining the exquisite and convex waistline and the plump and proud figure. The spring light was half hidden, which was extremely attractive.
Mo Yu leaned on the edge of the door and spoke warmly.
"Yi'an."
"Sweetheart told me that you also want to come with us."
"I've asked someone to take care of the stalls in the restaurant for you. Clean them up and come with us."
Zhen Yi'an stopped stirring the stir-fry in his hands and turned around in shock.
